title: Shellshock
overview:
Being the rookie member of a mercenary tank force isn't easy - and these guys aren't going to give you any special treatment.

You'll be taking an all-expenses-paid trip to global war zones and the chance to prove you're capable of handling the M13 Predator over Shellshock's 25 increasingly tough missions.

Mess up and the enemies, weather conditions and harsh terrain aren't the only hostile elements you'll be facing...

But cheer up Green - with some wicked trip-hop tunes and the opportunity to upgrade back at base, you'll soon show them you can handle this explosive 3D blast.
